So today we're catching up with a double Devlog, and there's a lot to cover! 🗺️ Zones 3 to 5: A Mountain Takes Shape This was an enormous amount of work: weeks of sculpting and level design across zones 3 to 5. In one week, more than 2000 players explored the mountains with Heidi for the first time, and your feedback has already shaped a first round of updates.
